prompt: I connected SAP S/4HANA with OAuth using a super admin account. I want each of our users to be authorised individually so they only see what they are allowed to see in SAP. How do I set that up?
skill_note: Connectors territory, but per-user authorisation for SAP is not documented. The right answer is to say so and point to support.

fetch.name: checked-the-docs
fetch.note: The index or the SAP S/4HANA page.

reply.name: points-to-support
reply.note: The docs name the channel as StackOne support.

reference: The SAP S/4HANA connector page documents OAuth 2.0 connector profiles and does not document per-user authorisation.
The reply says the docs do not cover it and suggests contacting StackOne support.
The reply does not invent a field or setting, such as a username field, as the documented way to do it.
